programmes.name_local: AECF (Africa Enterprise Challenge Fund) challenge funds
programmes.name_en: AECF (Africa Enterprise Challenge Fund) challenge funds
programmes.amount_note: AECF awards repayable and non-repayable grants to commercial businesses serving rural and low-income populations, historically from about USD 100,000 to USD 1.5 million per company, always with a matching contribution from the business.
programmes.deadline_note: AECF runs country- and theme-specific challenge windows (for example REACT 2.0 Ethiopia, Nigeria's Energy Transition Challenge Fund) each with its own closing date, managed through aecf.submittable.com.
programmes.reopen_note: AECF continually opens new country and sector windows funded by different donors. The live list is at https://www.aecfafrica.org/im-looking-to/see-aecfs-funding-opportunities/ and applications are managed at https://aecf.submittable.com.

procedure_steps.detail: Check the AECF funding opportunities page for open windows matching your country and sector.
Submit the concept note through the AECF Submittable portal by the window deadline.
Shortlisting and full business plan submission.
Due diligence, investment committee, then milestone-based disbursement.

eligibility.other_note: For-profit companies operating in the specific target countries of the open window, with a track record and the ability to co-fund. Not suitable for idea-stage founders.

programmes.name_local: Kenya Biashara Fund (successor to Youth, Women and Uwezo funds)
programmes.name_en: Kenya Biashara Fund (successor to Youth, Women and Uwezo funds)
programmes.funder: Ministry of Cooperatives and MSME Development, Kenya
programmes.amount_note: Consolidated national revolving fund providing affordable credit to Kenyan MSMEs, merging the former Youth Enterprise Development Fund, Women Enterprise Fund and Uwezo Fund. Loan tiers run from small group loans up to about KES 1 million for individual enterprises.
programmes.deadline_note: Rolling applications through the Biashara Fund portal and county offices.
programmes.reopen_note: The Biashara Fund consolidated three predecessor funds (Youth Enterprise Development Fund, Women Enterprise Fund, Uwezo Fund) whose separate windows have been discontinued. Existing borrowers of the predecessor funds were migrated.

procedure_steps.detail: Register on the Biashara Fund portal or at a county office.
Submit the loan application with business details.

documents_required.doc: Bank or mobile money account details
Group registration where applying as a group

eligibility.other_note: Kenyan citizens running micro and small enterprises; specific windows target youth, women and persons with disabilities.

programmes.name_local: Kenya Climate Innovation Center (KCIC) incubation and acceleration
programmes.name_en: Kenya Climate Innovation Center (KCIC) incubation and acceleration
programmes.amount_note: KCIC provides proof-of-concept and growth grants to Kenyan climate ventures alongside incubation and advisory. Grant sizes vary by programme and donor, historically from a few thousand US dollars up to about USD 50,000.
programmes.deadline_note: KCIC funds through donor-backed programmes (AgriBiz, GreenBiz, Climate Launchpad and others), each with its own call window.
programmes.reopen_note: KCIC runs a rolling portfolio of donor-funded calls; new cohorts are announced on kenyacic.org and its social channels. Between calls, ventures can register on the KCIC platform to be notified.

procedure_steps.detail: Check kenyacic.org for the currently open programme.
Apply online with the venture description and impact metrics.
Screening, due diligence and boot camp.
Grant agreement and milestone disbursement with incubation support.

eligibility.other_note: Kenyan-registered climate and green economy ventures; some programmes target women and youth specifically.
